issue.title: Nav unit tests still pin walkMode v4 and a hex-free stylesheet tail after d0726f6 (w dot, tier-matched s hues)
issue.description:
Repo: bob-plugins (linked), master cf25d60 (also reproduced on d0726f6 itself).

Commit d0726f6 "feat(navigation): add w over-limit dot, tier-matched s hues, and reliable b dot"
(agent bbugyi200.apollo.eh, no bead) bumped the nav `api.walkMode` to v5 and added
`--color-*` hex fallbacks for the bracket-mode attention tiers, but did not update the
unit tests that pin those contracts. Five tests now fail deterministically:

- scripts/test-navigation-bracket-repeat.cjs:644 "walkMode api is versioned and the top-level api version is unchanged" (5 !== 4)
- scripts/test-navigation-bracket-repeat.cjs:755 "walkMode degrades with a null plugin"
- scripts/test-navigation-bracket-repeat.cjs "walkMode.setAttention validates type and value"
- scripts/test-navigation-period-links.cjs:207 "walkMode.links matches the first destination [n and ]n would open" ("daily aliases" 5 !== 4)
- scripts/test-navigation-hotkeys-priority-notice.cjs:351 "priority notice stylesheet scopes Obsidian notice overrides and uses theme tokens":
  its hex guard slices styles.css from "/* --- Priority notice" to EOF, which now
  includes `button.bob-bracket-mode-seg.has-attention[data-attention-tier=...]` rules
  with hex fallbacks (#00bfbc, #e93147, #7852ee, #e0ac00, #08b94e, #d53984, #086ddd,
  #c65367) around styles.css line ~4300.

Evidence: on a worktree at 6b5a7b3 (d0726f6's parent) these files pass; at d0726f6 they
fail (8 fails vs 3, the other 3 being the separate Platform-shadowing reds). Found
while landing epic bob-cli-mc (full npm test: 14 fails, 5 of them these).

Fix: update the pinned walkMode version expectations to 5 (and any v5 shape changes),
and either scope the priority-notice hex guard to its own section (stop at the next
section marker) or allowlist the attention-tier fallbacks the way the test already
allowlists #d9822b / #3f8f5f. Run the three files plus `npm test`.
